question: How does worship of other names still reach the Lord?
premises: leaf flower fruit water offered with devotion are accepted
no worshippable thing exists apart from brahman
difference arises only through improper rite
inference: all worship ultimately reaches the Lord though rite quality differs
uncertainties: long fused compounds and corrupt readings
plain_english: Offerings made with devotion are accepted, and even worship under other names reaches me, since nothing worshippable exists apart from brahman; the difference lies in proper or improper rite.
